animation_tools: Open animation editing, cleanup, Smart Key, and snapping commands.
smart_key: Set a key at the current frame using the active Graph Editor, Channel Box, or object context.
smart_key_all: Set keys on every keyable scalar channel of the selected objects.
euler_filter: Apply the smart Euler filter to rotation curves in the active animation context.
snap: Move sub-frame keys onto whole frames. When the destination already has a key, keep it and merge the sub-frame key into it.
clear_animation: Delete all animation from the selected objects when no narrower animation selection is active.
Selection mode deletes only the active Graph Editor keys, Channel Box channels, or Time Slider range.
crop: Keep keys inside the active range and remove keys outside it.
remove_redundant: Remove redundant keys using the mode selected from the right-click menu.
remove_redundant_flat: Remove only interior keys from flat-value runs. Non-flat motion keys are left untouched.
remove_redundant_all: Simplify all redundant keys on the active curves while preserving the current key selection.
remove_static: Remove animation curves whose values do not change in the active context.
reverse: Reverse the active animation range in time.
copy_keys: Copy keys from the active animation context.
cut_keys: Cut keys from the active animation context.
delete_keys: Delete keys at the active frame or selected key context.
paste_keys: Paste copied keys at the active context.
paste_keys_relative: Paste copied keys relative to the current frame.
clear_selected: Clear the current Graph Editor key selection.
select_scene: Select every animation curve in the scene.
delete_before: Delete selected objects' keys before the current frame.
delete_after: Delete selected objects' keys after the current frame.
